Name: Mary, Mother of Jesus
Summary: Mary was the young virgin of Nazareth chosen to bear Jesus, the Son of God. Her humble surrender and lifelong faith, from manger to cross to upper room, make her a model of trust.
KeyStory: When the angel announced she would conceive the Son of the Most High, Mary answered, I am the Lord's servant; may Your word to me be fulfilled.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; Joseph, Husband of Mary; Elizabeth
LifeLesson: Mary treasured and pondered God's work even when a sword pierced her own soul. Say yes to God, treasure His word, and trust Him through both wonder and pain.
